body: FORMAL BLOCK on cand-3TGJX24DY5WG59H1E630VWQY92 / ebc7a519, on one enforceability defect. The successor states the correct scientific rule: controls are fresh complete runs, empty-after-removal is an ablation rather than abstention, and AblationResult must stay out of calibration. Source still permits a counterexample the named mutation cannot identify. Candidates.without returns ordinary Candidates; GraphHsmm.infer accepts that value and returns an ordinary HsmmResult; HsmmResult retains candidateAnchors and explicitly says nomination provenance remains residual. AblationResult protects only callers who choose ablationUngated. A caller can therefore remove the last channel, call ordinary infer, obtain Unranked, and submit an HsmmResult with no published field that differs from provider abstention. The mutation row says provenance identifies the ablation, but no such provenance exists today. Narrow repair: state that this path makes execution nonconforming until a typed or checked operation-derived ablation boundary/receipt exists; ordinary infer and control evidence must refuse it; mutate by bypassing or falsifying that boundary and require failure. Preserve the independent-run rule, typed AblationResult exclusion, report separation, estimand, and all previously accepted content. No file edited and no other blocker raised.
